utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Hi Grandma! How have you been?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, I've been lovely, dear! I was just getting the piano ready for our lesson today.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Yeah, I love sharing my favorite songs with you. Do you have any favorites from when you were my age?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I certainly do! But first, let's see how you've been practicing that Mozart piece I showed you.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! I really appreciate your support. It means a lot to me that you're teaching me.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I understand, dear. Take your time with the scales and let me know if you need help with the fingering.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I'll definitely let you know, Grandma. By the way, what was your favorite song when you were my age?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: It was a beautiful Chopin nocturne. We can take a break and I'll play it for you later if you like.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma. I think a break sounds good. Maybe we can listen to some of your favorite songs together?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That's a wonderful idea. I'm here to support your musical journey, whether we are playing or just listening.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: No worries, Grandma. I appreciate you being here for me. Let's enjoy some music together.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That's wonderful to hear, dear! I'm glad you're enjoying the piano. Keep up the great work!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandma! I'm really looking forward to it. Do you have a favorite song in mind to play next?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: It sounds like you're really getting the hang of the rhythm! I'm so proud of you for sticking with it.
